title: Pyruvylation of STAT1 inhibits anti-viral immunity: Prospects for new anti-viral therapeutics
authors: Anne F. McGettrick, Luke A.J. O’Neill
abstract: In a recent issue of Cell, Zuo et al. reveal a STAT1 modification by pyruvate, reducing type I interferon signaling. This study provides a possible explanation for why hyperglycemia in diabetes can impair anti-viral immunity and indicates a new way to boost anti-viral innate immunity.

title: INSTALLing recombinase-driven genome writing: Engineered single-stranded donors bypass innate immunity to enable large DNA integration
abstract: In a recent Nature article, Tou et al. introduce INSTALL, a strategy that couples immune-evasive circular single-stranded DNA (cssDNA) technology with recombinase-based genome editing to overcome innate immune barriers and enable the integration of large DNA cargos.
